markdown.description:
**Getting Started with Mailchain:**

To send emails using the Mailchain Protocol, you need to first create an account on [Mailchain](https://app.mailchain.com/). Once your account is set up, you will receive a Mailchain address. You can also connect your wallet to associate a blockchain address with your Mailchain account.

**Recipients:**

When sending an email, you can use either a Mailchain address or a blockchain address as the recipient. For blockchain addresses, you can leverage supported web3 domain services, including ENS, Unstoppable Domains, Lens, Coinbase, and many more.

**Example Usage:**
- **Mailchain Address:** 'yourname@mailchain.com'
- **Blockchain Address:** 'yourname.eth' (ENS), 'yourname.crypto' (Unstoppable Domains), etc.

To manage your inbox and send emails, visit [Mailchain's Web App](https://app.mailchain.com/).

to.description: The blockchain or mailchain addresses to send the email to

aiMetadata.description: Sends an email over the Mailchain protocol from the connected account to one or more recipients, which may be blockchain or Mailchain addresses. The same text body is sent as both plain text and HTML. Use to deliver decentralized messages; each call sends a new email, so it is not idempotent.

nl.**Getting Started with Mailchain:**\n\nT:
**Aan de slag met Mailchain:**

Om e-mails te verzenden via het Mailchain Protocol, moet u eerst een account aanmaken op [Mailchain](https://app.mailchain.com/). Zodra uw account is ingesteld, ontvangt u een mailchain adres. U kunt ook uw portemonnee verbinden om een blockchainadres te koppelen aan uw Mailchain account.

**geadresseerden:**

Bij het verzenden van een e-mail kan je of een mailchain adres of een blockchain-adres gebruiken als ontvanger. Voor blockchainadressen, kunt u ondersteunde web3-domeindiensten gebruiken, waaronder ENS, Unstoppable Domains, Lens, Coinbase, en nog veel meer.

**Voorbeeld Gebruik:**
- **Mailchain Adres:** 'yourname@mailchain.
- **Blockchain adres:** 'yourname.eth' (ENS), 'yourname.crypto' (niet te stoppen), etc.

Om uw inbox te beheren en e-mails te versturen, bezoek [Mailchain's Web App](https://app.mailchain.com/).

de.**Getting Started with Mailchain:**\n\nT:
**Erste Schritte mit Mailchain:**

Um E-Mails mit dem Mailchain-Protokoll zu senden, musst du zuerst ein Konto bei [Mailchain](https://app.mailchain.com/). Sobald Ihr Konto eingerichtet ist, erhalten Sie eine Mailchain-Adresse. Sie können Ihre Brieftasche auch verbinden, um eine Blockchain Adresse mit Ihrem Mailchain Konto zu verknüpfen.

**Empfänger:**

Beim Senden einer E-Mail können Sie entweder eine Mailchain-Adresse oder eine Blockchain-Adresse als Empfänger verwenden. Bei Blockchain-Adressen können Sie unterstützte web3-Domain-Dienste nutzen, einschließlich ENS, Unstoppable Domains, Lens, Coinbase und viele andere.

**Verwendung:**
- **Mailchain Adresse:** 'yourname@mailchain. om'
- **Blockchain-Adresse:** 'yourname.eth' (ENS), 'yourname.crypto' (Unstoppbare Domains), etc.

Um deinen Posteingang zu verwalten und E-Mails zu senden, besuche [Mailchain's Web App](https://app.mailchain.com/).

pt.**Getting Started with Mailchain:**\n\nT:
**Primeiros passos com Mailchain:**

Para enviar e-mails usando o protocolo Mailchain, você precisa primeiro criar uma conta no [Mailchain](https://app.mailchain.com/). Assim que sua conta estiver configurada, você receberá um endereço de Mailchain. Você também pode conectar sua carteira para associar um endereço blockchain à sua conta de Mailchain.

**destinatários:**

Quando enviar um e-mail, você pode usar um endereço de correio eletrônico ou um endereço de blockchain como destinatário. Para endereços blockchain, você poderá alavancar serviços de domínio suportados pelo web3, incluindo ENS, Domínios Iparáveis, Lens, Coinbase e muito mais.

**Exemplo de uso:**
- **Mailchain Address:** 'yourname@mailchain. om'
- **Endereço de Blockchain:** 'yourname.eth' (ENS), 'yourname.crypto' (Domínios Imparáveis), etc.

Para gerenciar sua caixa de entrada e enviar e-mails, visite [Aplicativo Web do Mailchain](https://app.mailchain.com/).
